exampleSentence: The latest statistics show a clear rise in online sales.
exampleTranslation: 最新统计数据表明，网上销售额明显上升。

exampleSentence: Farmers in this region grow soy for food and animal feed.
exampleTranslation: 该地区的农民种植大豆，用于食品和动物饲料。

exampleSentence: The children were playing football on the playground after school.
exampleTranslation: 放学后，孩子们在操场上踢足球。

exampleSentence: He tried to deceive his parents about his exam results.
exampleTranslation: 他试图就考试成绩欺骗父母。

exampleSentence: Our team hopes to win the final match on Saturday.
exampleTranslation: 我们队希望赢得周六的决赛。

exampleSentence: I think I left my keys somewhere in the living room.
exampleTranslation: 我想我把钥匙落在客厅的某个地方了。

exampleSentence: The instructions are written in plain English so everyone can follow them.
exampleTranslation: 这些说明用简单易懂的英语写成，以便每个人都能照着做。

exampleSentence: The essence of the plan is to reduce waste and save money.
exampleTranslation: 这个计划的本质是减少浪费、节省开支。

exampleSentence: The rope went slack after the weight was removed.
exampleTranslation: 重物移开后，绳子松了。

exampleSentence: The doctors plan to transplant a kidney into the young patient next week.
exampleTranslation: 医生计划下周给这位年轻患者移植一颗肾脏。

exampleSentence: Her only complaint was that the hotel room was too noisy.
exampleTranslation: 她唯一的抱怨是酒店房间太吵。

exampleSentence: These new findings contradict the earlier report.
exampleTranslation: 这些新发现与早先的报告相矛盾。

exampleSentence: The path begins to incline steeply as it approaches the ridge.
exampleTranslation: 小路在接近山脊时开始陡峭地向上倾斜。

exampleSentence: The battery in my phone lasts only a few hours when I watch videos.
exampleTranslation: 我看视频时，手机电池只能维持几个小时。

exampleSentence: Her acceptance of the job offer surprised her friends.
exampleTranslation: 她接受了这份工作邀请，这让朋友们很意外。

exampleSentence: A thick layer of snow can cover the garden overnight.
exampleTranslation: 一夜之间，厚厚的一层雪就能覆盖花园。

exampleSentence: She instinctively pulled her hand away from the hot pan.
exampleTranslation: 她本能地把手从热锅上缩了回来。

exampleSentence: He has been learning to play the guitar since he was ten.
exampleTranslation: 他从十岁起就在学弹吉他。

exampleSentence: The company plans to hire ten new engineers this year.
exampleTranslation: 公司计划今年雇用十名新工程师。

exampleSentence: Please don't misunderstand me; I support your decision.
exampleTranslation: 请不要误解我，我支持你的决定。

exampleSentence: The diversion of traffic to a side road eased congestion in the town center.
exampleTranslation: 将车流转移到辅路，缓解了市中心的拥堵。

exampleSentence: He has been my closest mate since we were in primary school.
exampleTranslation: 从小学起，他一直是我最亲密的伙伴。

exampleSentence: The town has changed greatly over the past decade.
exampleTranslation: 过去十年里，这座小镇发生了巨大变化。

exampleSentence: Such a long climb would exhaust even experienced hikers.
exampleTranslation: 这样长的攀登会让经验丰富的徒步者也筋疲力尽。

exampleSentence: The company's gross income rose by ten percent last year.
exampleTranslation: 公司去年的总收入增长了百分之十。
